lines.speaker: cultist
lines.text: ...o sleeper in the dark, we bring you warmth, we bring you breath...

lines.speaker: cultist
lines.text: ...one given freely, one given gladly, one given whether they like it or not...

lines.speaker: pilot
lines.text: Is that... one of my crew's boots sticking out of the sarcophagus?

lines.speaker: cultist
lines.text: ...the vessel hungers, the vessel is fed, soon the vessel shall wake...

lines.speaker: pilot
lines.text: Right. Okay. I have some decisions to make.
